title: Future of FinOps Summit 2026
description: A one-day leadership summit for finance, cloud, and platform teams focused on FinOps governance, AI-era cost controls, unit economics, forecasting, and executive operating models.

agendaItems.description: Attendee check-in, badge pickup, coffee, and networking.

agendaItems.agendaTitle: Opening Keynote: FinOps in the AI Era
agendaItems.description: How AI workloads are changing cloud economics, governance, and executive decision-making.

agendaItems.agendaTitle: Executive Panel: Budget Discipline Without Slowing Innovation
agendaItems.description: CFOs and platform leaders discuss budget controls, chargeback models, and team accountability.

agendaItems.agendaTitle: Workshop: Building a FinOps Operating Model
agendaItems.description: Interactive workshop covering ownership, KPIs, cost reviews, and tooling design.

agendaItems.agendaTitle: Closing Session: From Cost Visibility to Action
agendaItems.description: A closing roadmap for operationalizing insights from the summit.

sessions.description: A keynote on AI workload economics, capital allocation, and executive reporting.
A panel on balancing governance, product speed, and cloud investment.

sessions.sessionTitle: Forecasting and Unit Economics for Cloud Leaders
sessions.description: Methods for rolling forecasts, scenario planning, and cost-per-product metrics.

ticketTiers.description: Full summit access, keynote seating, lunch, and networking sessions.
Priority check-in, premium seating, leadership roundtable, and speaker lounge access.
Reserved allocation for strategic partners and invited ecosystem delegates.
